summary: Bread Financial Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing the pricing of an underwritten public offering of 4,800,000 depositary shares, each representing a 1/40th interest in its 8.875% Fixed Rate Reset Non-Cumulative Perpetual Preferred Stock, Series B, with a liquidation preference of $25 per depositary share. The underwriters, led by Morgan Stanley, RBC, UBS, Wells Fargo, and Keefe Bruyette & Woods, have a 30-day option for an additional 720,000 shares. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes, including potential contributions to its subsidiary bank and share repurchases. This is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
